knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The cost per job won over a fixed trial, including bidding time, is the measure that decides whether the platform pays. The other options are not evidence of value.
A claim is acceptable only when the owner holds the cover and can show the certificate. Copied reviews, unheld licences and client addresses are not acceptable.
The guide's platforms are not used as Australian recommendations. The owner must check which platforms operate locally, and their terms, before joining any.

practicalCriteria: Learner produces a platform comparison table in which each fee and term is checked on the platform's own site and dated.
Learner writes a profile in which every licence or insurance claim is backed by a document in the business file.
Learner calculates the cost per job won from a sample trial log.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Platform comparison table with check dates
Sample trial log and cost calculation
stopWorkCriteria: Learner posts a client's personal address or contact details on a public profile.
